classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

cornerRadius.description: The radius applied to arc corners (similar to border radius).

dataIndex.description: The index of the data point in the series.

innerRadius.description: The radius between circle center and the beginning of the arc.

isFocused.description: If true, the element has keyboard focus.

outerRadius.description: The radius between circle center and the end of the arc.

paddingAngle.description: The padding angle (deg) between two arcs.

seriesId.description: The id of the series the element belongs to.

skipInteraction.description: If true, the default event handlers are disabled. Those are used, for example, to display a tooltip or highlight the arc on hover.

animate.description: Styles applied when animation is not skipped.

arcLabel.nodeName: an individual pie arc label element

root.description: Styles applied to the root element.

series.nodeName: the g element that contains all pie arcs of a series

seriesLabels.nodeName: the g element that contains all pie arc labels of a series
